title: Words to read and colour: Madd and shaddah reading check
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 44 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 44. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Madd and shaddah reading check). Then trace and copy.

questions.q: Reading check: today's group reads the card to the teacher. Everyone else reads it softly and ticks each word on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Teacher records secure or developing for each row.

questions.q: Extend: read row 3 without looking at the slide (from the mushaf).

questions.a: A) thumma. Dammah on ث, shaddah and fathah on م: thum-ma.

questions.q: Think again: Think back to March. What can you read now that you could not read then?
questions.a: Madd letters and shaddah words, and short lines from the mushaf.
